newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOFTLINE BUYS ISU CAMPUS FOR 12.5 MLN RAND.
newsitem.headline: SOFTLINE BUYS ISU CAMPUS FOR 12.5 MLN RAND.

text.p: South African information technology group Softline Ltd said on Tuesday it had bought training and education firm ISU Campus for 12.5 million rand.
The price will be settled by the issue of new Softline shares half of which had been placed with financial institutions and the other half would be retained by the vendors, the firm said.
ISU has a staff of 90 people, the majority of whom are Microsoft certified trainers and system engineers, and the present management is to remain in place.

Softline said the acquisition would complement its Softline Training Institute, an instructor-led, applications and Internet training facility and MasterSkill Training, a group company specialising in the provision of technology-based training products.
"The acquisition will position Softline as a dominant player in IT education and training sector," chief executive officer Ivan Epstein said in a statement.
